title: The People Confess Their Sin

questions.question: What was Ezra doing while a great assembly gathered?
options: Praying and making confession, weeping and casting himself down
questions.correctAnswer: Praying and making confession, weeping and casting himself down
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:1 (ESV): "While Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down..."

questions.question: Who spoke up and proposed a covenant to put away the foreign wives?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:2 (ESV): "And Shecaniah the son of Jehiel... addressed Ezra..."

questions.question: What proclamation was made throughout Judah and Jerusalem?
options: That all the returned exiles should assemble at Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: That all the returned exiles should assemble at Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:7 (ESV): "And a proclamation was made throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the returned exiles that they should assemble at Jerusalem..."

questions.question: What would happen to anyone who did not come within three days?
options: His property should be forfeited and he himself banned from the congregation
questions.correctAnswer: His property should be forfeited and he himself banned from the congregation
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:8 (ESV): "...all his property should be forfeited and he himself banned from the congregation of the exiles."

questions.question: Why were the people trembling in the open square?
options: Because of this matter and because of the heavy rain
questions.correctAnswer: Because of this matter and because of the heavy rain
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:9 (ESV): "...trembling because of this matter and because of the heavy rain."

questions.question: Did the people agree to Ezra's demand?
options: Yes, "As you have said, we must do"
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, "As you have said, we must do"
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:12 (ESV): "Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, 'It is so; we must do as you have said.'"

questions.question: Why did they not do it immediately right there?
options: The people are many, and it is a time of heavy rain
questions.correctAnswer: The people are many, and it is a time of heavy rain
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:13 (ESV): "But the people are many, and it is a time of heavy rain; we cannot stand in the open..."

questions.question: How long did the examination of the matter take?
options: From the first day of the tenth month to the first day of the first month
questions.correctAnswer: From the first day of the tenth month to the first day of the first month
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:16-17 (ESV): "...And they sat down on the first day of the tenth month... And... by the first day of the first month."

questions.question: Who opposed the plan?
options: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah
questions.correctAnswer: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:15 (ESV): "Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah opposed this..."

questions.question: What offering did the priests with foreign wives make?
options: A ram of the flock for their guilt
questions.correctAnswer: A ram of the flock for their guilt
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:19 (ESV): "...and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt."

questions.question: Where did Ezra go after leaving the court of the temple?
options: The chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib
questions.correctAnswer: The chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:6 (ESV): "Then Ezra withdrew... and went to the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib..."

questions.question: What did Ezra do in the chamber of Jehohanan?
options: He ate no bread and drank no water, for he mourned
questions.correctAnswer: He ate no bread and drank no water, for he mourned
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:6 (ESV): "...where he spent the night, neither eating bread nor drinking water, for he was mourning..."

questions.question: Who supported the opposition along with Jonathan and Jahzeiah?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:15 (ESV): "...and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supported them."

questions.question: Which sons of the priests were found to have foreign wives?
options: Sons of Jeshua, Immer, Harim, and Pashhur
questions.correctAnswer: Sons of Jeshua, Immer, Harim, and Pashhur
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:18-20 (ESV): Lists the sons of Jeshua, Immer, Harim, Pashhur.

questions.question: What did they pledge to do?
questions.explanation: Ezra 10:19 (ESV): "They pledged themselves to put away their wives..."

key_verse_text: Now then make confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers and do his will. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives.
